beats.say: Not round. Not lumpy. Perfect little *squares!*
Meet the *wombat*, a chubby digger from Australia.
But its bottom is *round*, just like ours.
The secret is hidden in its *gut.*
The gut wall has stiff bands and *stretchy* bands.
Squeeze by squeeze, they press the poop into sharp *corners.*
Up to *one hundred* cubes, every single night!
It leaves them on rocks to mark its *territory.*
Round poop would roll off. Cubes *stay put!*
So next time you meet a wombat... remember:
